title: Sisi Receives Qatari PM as Joint Higher Committee Convenes; Egypt-Qatar Economic Partnership Talks Set for October
detail: President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi received Qatar's Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani in Cairo on August 20, 2026, as Doha led its delegation to the seventh session of the Egyptian-Qatari Joint Higher Committee. Sheikh Mohammed also met Egyptian Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly and Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty. Talks covered Gaza ceasefire implementation, regional de-escalation, and maritime security, alongside deeper bilateral trade and investment ties; Sisi called for greater Qatari investment in Egypt, and the two governments announced the first round of negotiations on a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement for October 2026.
